description: You are a mechanical engineer preparing HVAC documentation for a residential building permit. Open the garage floor plan at '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan.dxf' in LibreCAD. The building owner wants to condition this 2-car garage for use as a workshop and needs a mechanical permit. Your task is to overlay a complete HVAC ductwork system on the floor plan following standard mechanical engineering drawing conventions. The overlay must show: (1) supply air duct routing from an assumed air handler unit location to each zone of the space, drawn as centerlines on dedicated supply air layers, (2) return air duct routing back to the air handler, (3) at least 3 supply diffuser or register locations marked with appropriate symbols (circles or crosses), (4) duct sizing callout annotations for each major duct segment (e.g., '12x8', '10x6', or expressed in CFM), (5) air handler unit location labeled, and (6) a separate notes layer with a duct sizing note or system summary. Use standard mechanical/HVAC layer naming conventions. Save the completed drawing to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/floorplan_hvac.dxf'.
